tutorial.dashboard.step.1.title: Welcome to Taskwolf
tutorial.dashboard.step.1.description: Hello, we have noticed that you are new to Taskwolf. We would like to give you a brief introduction to the product below. If you want to continue, click on "Continue", if not, click on "Cancel".
tutorial.dashboard.step.2.title: The Dashboard
tutorial.dashboard.step.2.description: Great, let's get started. On this page you will find an overview of Taskwolf.
tutorial.workflows.step.1.title: Workflows
tutorial.workflows.step.1.description: Workflows are one of the most important features of Taskwolf.
tutorial.workflows.step.2.title: Workflows
tutorial.workflows.step.2.description: They form a bridge between different services and enable great automation and time savings.
tutorial.workflows.step.3.title: Create Workflow
tutorial.workflows.step.3.description: You can create a workflow at any time by clicking here.
tutorial.workflow.step.1.title: Workflow
tutorial.workflow.step.1.description: When you create a workflow, you will be redirected to the following page. Here you will find all the important components that a workflow must have.
tutorial.workflow.step.2.title: Workflow Trigger
tutorial.workflow.step.2.description: Let's start by looking at the trigger of the workflow. The trigger is there to start the workflow.
tutorial.workflow.step.3.title: Workflow Action
tutorial.workflow.step.3.description: The second important component of every workflow is the action. It gives meaning to the workflow by determining the action after triggering.
tutorial.workflow.step.4.title: To save you time...
tutorial.workflow.step.4.description: Now you know the basic structure of workflows. Let's move on to the templates.
tutorial.templates.step.1.title: Templates
tutorial.templates.step.1.description: We have taken a lot of time to put together popular workflow templates for you. You can add these to your repertoire of workflows and concretize them free of charge.
tutorial.templates.step.2.title: Template usage
tutorial.templates.step.2.description: Once you have selected a suitable template, you can simply click on it. It will then be automatically made available to you for customization.
tutorial.processes.step.1.title: Processes
tutorial.processes.step.1.description: Let's continue with the Taskwolf process system. Processes can be seen as a superordinate instance of workflows.
tutorial.processes.step.2.title: Processes
tutorial.processes.step.2.description: They are used to connect workflows with each other and represent regulated processes.
tutorial.processes.step.3.title: Create Process
tutorial.processes.step.3.description: You can create a process at any time by clicking here.
tutorial.process.step.1.title: Process
tutorial.process.step.1.description: As soon as you have pressed this button, the following page will appear. The process is created here.
tutorial.process.step.2.title: Process Step
tutorial.process.step.2.description: Each process consists of several steps. These are to be understood as separate instances and contain todos or notes and can execute workflows. You can display all these settings by clicking on a step.
tutorial.process.step.3.title: Process Step Connections
tutorial.process.step.3.description: The individual steps can be set in relation to each other by connecting them. The connections between the individual steps specify the order in which a process is executed.
tutorial.process.step.4.title: Execute Process
tutorial.process.step.4.description: There are different ways to execute a process, which you can find under the dropdown. The standard execution method is the execution of individual steps one after the other.
tutorial.process.step.5.title: Publish Process
tutorial.process.step.5.description: Once you have finished creating the process, you can save it using the button displayed.
tutorial.databases.step.1.title: Databases
tutorial.databases.step.1.description: Now we come to the somewhat smaller side features of Taskwolf. One of them is databases.
tutorial.databases.step.2.title: Databases
tutorial.databases.step.2.description: Databases can be used to store data without much effort. They can also be automated using workflows, for example.
tutorial.databases.step.3.title: Create Database
tutorial.databases.step.3.description: If you want to take a closer look at the system, you can click on the "Create" button. Otherwise, we'll move on to the next feature.
tutorial.webhooks.step.1.title: Webhooks
tutorial.webhooks.step.1.description: The next feature should be of particular interest to you if you are a developer. But it is also very helpful in other respects.
tutorial.webhooks.step.2.title: Webhooks
tutorial.webhooks.step.2.description: We are talking about webhooks. They enable the external triggering of workflows. These can be used, for example, to integrate Taskwolf into your existing infrastructure.
tutorial.webhooks.step.3.title: Create Webhook
tutorial.webhooks.step.3.description: As with the other features, creation is very simple. Click on "Continue" to proceed.
tutorial.organizations.step.1.title: Organizations
tutorial.organizations.step.1.descriptio: Organizations offer the opportunity to automate together as a team with the help of Taskwolf.
tutorial.organizations.step.2.title: Organizations
tutorial.organizations.step.2.descriptio: In an organization, you have common workflows, processes, databases and much more.
tutorial.organizations.step.3.title: Create Organization
tutorial.organizations.step.3.descriptio: To create an organization and invite your team members, simply click here.
tutorial.accounts.step.1.title: Accounts
tutorial.accounts.step.1.description: In the course of using Taskwolf, you will have to link various accounts in order to operate automation.
tutorial.accounts.step.2.title: Accounts
tutorial.accounts.step.2.description: To keep track of the accounts, they are listed here for you. You can also easily manage and remove them again by clicking on the desired app.
tutorial.devices.step.1.title: Devices
tutorial.devices.step.1.description: Let's move on to the last feature: devices. You can use our app to automate your personal devices.
tutorial.devices.step.2.title: Devices
tutorial.devices.step.2.description: You can integrate the devices into workflows and send notifications, execute commands or manage files.
tutorial.help.step.1.title: Help
tutorial.help.step.1.description: If you have any further questions, you may find your answer here.
tutorial.help.step.2.title: Help
tutorial.help.step.2.description: If your question has not been answered, you will also find the necessary contact options to contact us personally.
tutorial.help.step.3.title: The end
tutorial.help.step.3.description: We have reached the end of our brief introduction to Taskwolf. We hope that you have been able to get to know the product better. Thank you for your attention.
